UI_RVVFX_VFXQuality_tooltip: Full uses 100 percent intended visual quality with automatic culling, caching, pooling, and extreme-crowd protection. Performance targets about half the normal workload. Potato targets about one quarter or less. Off disables RVV effects and tire marks on this client.
UI_CWCompat_LifestyleDescription: Compatibility and presentation options for Lifestyle: Hobbies.
UI_CWCompat_ShowHiddenSkills_tooltip: Shows Lifestyle's hidden Yoga, Inventing, Ping Pong, Pool, and Arcade progression under the Lifestyle category. This only changes the display; Lifestyle remains the owner of progression data.
